title: Data set and resources
goal: Execute actual DCS for two own requests, reconciling2/75 and then1/45.
prerequisites: onec.p8; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: DCS separates data description, settings, layout and output. A schema defines datasets, fields, relationships and parameters. TheMinutes resource specifies aggregation rather than merely a numeric column. Define dataset granularity and a three-document expectation before using a designer.

The complete source creates own30/45 documents, builds a DataCompositionSchema and outputs a value collection. Fields include reference/customer/minutes. A customer-reference filter isolates the experiment in a growing base. This is an actual DCS processor, not JavaScript arithmetic.

An already customer-grouped dataset can be summed again only with correct multiplicity. A bad join doubles resources beforeDCS. Check raw query rows before report groupings. A computed field with a nice name cannot repair lost or extra records.

Separate the Local source, query dataset, declared fields and output settings. DataPath connects available fields to structure. A schema is not a result: the layout composer applies settings, the processor executes the layout and the output processor returns a table.
Settings differ from the source set

One schema can support multiple report variants. Users change available fields, filters and groupings without silently gaining forbidden data scope. Check permissions and dataset restrictions separately. Preserve variant and parameters so another reviewer reproduces the same question.

First expect two detail rows/75. No extra total row is added to those details, avoiding double summation. When designing grouped output separately, specify the result grain and distinguish detail from aggregate rows.

For 30/45/15, expect 90 minutes and customer groups 75/15. Reconcile detail and grand total, then include a request-free customer and empty period. Change one record in a copy and regenerate. A prior saved result does not prove a fresh run; show parameters, time and membership.

Recompose the same input with minutes>30: expect only the second reference/45. Changing the threshold to45 yields no rows and distinguishes semantics despite valid syntax. Retain settings, source and both outputs.
